runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Candidate-specific reconciliation across Planning Data, LBBD committee decisions, Be First project records and the current June 2026 Council company update; net capacity is arithmetically reconciled while current delivery delay is preserved.

sources.label: Planning Data LBBD91/DI
sources.fact: LBBD91/DI identifies 53-135 Roxwell Road, 0.58ha, publicly owned, deliverable, permissioned with full planning permission and both minimum/maximum net dwellings equal to 46; geometry is blank.

sources.label: Planning Data DI permission metadata
sources.fact: Brownfield record gives planning-permission date 2020-07-10 and one Be First planning-history identifier; these metadata do not provide exact title geometry.

sources.label: LBBD Planning Committee 23 March 2020
sources.fact: Committee item 49 is 53-135 Roxwell Road and 2-4 Stebbing Way, application 19/01920/FUL, with delegated grant subject to the Unilateral Undertaking and conditions.

sources.label: LBBD Section 73 committee 2021
sources.fact: September 2021 committee considered a Section 73 application varying conditions of permission 19/01920/FUL and explicitly describes construction of 87 Class C3 residential units.

sources.label: Be First approval summary
sources.fact: Be First states Roxwell/Stebbing will provide 87 new homes replacing 41 existing homes.

sources.label: Be First net increase
sources.fact: The 87-new/41-replaced figures arithmetically imply a net increase of 46, matching the Brownfield register's 46 net dwellings.

sources.label: Be First planning submission
sources.fact: Be First's project consultation page separately states 87 high-quality new homes and an increase of 46 affordable energy-efficient homes.

sources.label: LBBD Cabinet 16 June 2026
sources.fact: Current Cabinet minutes record delays after original contractor Jerram Falkus Construction Limited entered administration before completion of the Roxwell Road project.

sources.label: LBBD Cabinet alternative contractor authority
sources.fact: Cabinet delegated authority to appoint an alternative contractor and increase budget if required subject to viability, so older planned completion dates are not treated as proof of completion.

sources.label: Current-delivery state rule
sources.fact: The June 2026 Council record is used as the newer delivery-state evidence and supersedes older schedule expectations for completion claims.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: The adopted 2037 Local Plan is current policy context but does not alter the exact permission/delivery facts for Roxwell.

sources.label: LBBD Development Plan
sources.fact: Development Plan status is kept separate from application reference, net capacity and current construction delivery evidence.

examples.result: 87 gross new homes minus 41 replaced existing homes equals 46 net, exactly reconciling the Brownfield net-dwellings field.
The 46-net reconciliation is accepted as a count reconciliation, not an exact parcel-boundary verification.
19/01920/FUL remains the exact parent permission reference; Section 73 changes are not counted as another 87-home scheme.
Older expected completion dates are not treated as current because the June 2026 Council record reports contractor administration and incomplete works.
Authority to appoint an alternative contractor is a recovery/delivery action, not proof that the project is completed.
Public ownership status in Brownfield data is not converted into an exact HMLR title-owner relation.
Blank Brownfield geometry is not reconstructed from the project address or planning point.
Promotion remains zero until exact title polygon and candidate-specific current statutory overlays are bound.

candidate_summary.current_delivery_blocker: original contractor entered administration before project completion
